scope: cryptographic and authorization operations used by the frozen CellScript 0.30 eight-family business corpus
claim: Each admitted row is either executable CellScript behavior or an exact composition boundary. External verifier and standard Lock internals are never counted as compiler-proved behavior.

domains.enforcement: A 32-byte Lock-args payload; it cannot satisfy ScriptHash or SighashAllDigest parameters without an explicit checked conversion.

domains.source_type: fixed witness fields plus bounded Merkle siblings and index
domains.enforcement: The declared witness owner, literal depth, leaf index, root comparison, and successor relation are checked together.

domains.source_type: [u8; 32] in the exact BIP340 adapter parameter position
domains.enforcement: The typed adapter fixes width, argument position, verifier identity, and IPC encoding; curve validation belongs to the pinned verifier.

domains.source_type: [u8; 64] in the exact BIP340 adapter parameter position
domains.enforcement: The typed adapter fixes width, argument position, verifier identity, and IPC encoding; signature validity belongs to the pinned verifier.
Owner and maximum are part of the type and runtime provenance; maximum is a literal in 0..=65536.

domains.source_type: Hash used in a declared commitment or Merkle-root position
domains.enforcement: The operation fixes algorithm, preimage shape, index/depth, witness owner, and equality site rather than treating any Hash as authority.
A fixed receipt/value encoding binds package, interface, artifact, deployment, network, role, selected Script, and verifier data identity.
A 32-byte digest or identity value that cannot be used as a complete ScriptHash or SighashAllDigest without an explicit conversion.
Canonical Molecule code hash, hash type, and bounded args are retained as one complete Script value or transaction view.
Only a complete transaction Script hash, canonical script::hash result, or explicit ckb::script_hash assertion enters this domain.
Only the bounded zero-Lock signing transform produces this value; Hash::from_sighash_all is the explicit escape to raw Hash.

domains.source_type: terminal success or exact zero child status
domains.enforcement: Verification operations do not return an authority-bearing byte value; failure terminates the Script or the checked child-status path.

bounds: Script args are fixed-width and at most 459 bytes
hash type is one of data, type, data1, or data2
capabilities.boundary: Constructing or comparing a Script hash does not prove that the Script is deployed or authorized.

bounds: fixed values or explicitly bounded spans
bounded witness owners admit at most 65536 bytes
capabilities.boundary: Only the named fixed or bounded gathering shapes are admitted; there is no unbounded allocator-backed hashing API.

bounds: public key is exactly 32 bytes
signature is exactly 64 bytes
explicit CellDep index is a literal in 0..=63
capabilities.boundary: The compiler checks identity, adapter, argument layout, statement placement, and zero success; it does not prove the verifier parser or BIP340 implementation.

algorithms: CKB Script hash or CellDep data hash comparison
bounds: handle value is exactly 202 bytes
handle and commitment are supplied through fixed typed witness fields
capabilities.boundary: An exact handle proves equality with the admitted identity axes; it does not prove business behavior outside the selected interface and entry.

bounds: exactly one 32-byte syscall result
capabilities.boundary: This is the raw transaction hash without witnesses; authorization requires a separately named message-domain transform.

bounds: one fixed 32-byte value or one fixed 64-byte pair
capabilities.boundary: These are fixed-shape hash helpers, not a general streaming SHA interface.

bounds: depth is a literal in 0..=16
siblings are [Hash; 16]
leaf index is checked against depth
capabilities.boundary: The compiler proves the declared bounded opening and successor equality only; it does not assign protocol meaning to the committed bytes.

algorithms: CKB multisig-v2 signing and Lock verification
bounds: the standard Lock binary and dependency identities are pinned in Cargo.lock
CellScript entry arguments remain in WitnessArgs.input_type
capabilities.witness_owner: WitnessArgs.lock for the standard Lock and WitnessArgs.input_type for CellScript
capabilities.boundary: CellScript preserves and composes the standard Lock witness; the compiler does not claim the system Lock's signature internals.

bounds: fixed u8 or hex4 adapters
SPAWN/WAIT IPC buffers and child status are bounded
capabilities.boundary: Successful delegation proves only the exact dependency, adapter, statement placement, and result contract; external semantics remain separately trusted.

algorithms: CKB SighashAll with the complete first group WitnessArgs.lock payload replaced by equal-length zero bytes
bounds: group inputs, transaction inputs, extra witnesses, and witness bytes are compile-time literals
group inputs are at most 64, inputs at most 256, extra witnesses at most 64, and each witness at most 65536 bytes
capabilities.witness_owner: WitnessArgs.lock plus later group and transaction witnesses in canonical order
capabilities.boundary: The generic env::sighash_all spelling and multisig prefix-preserving transforms remain unavailable; multisig uses the exact standard Lock boundary.

deferred: generic env::sighash_all without a named witness transform
multisig prefix-preserving message construction inside CellScript
arbitrary signature algorithms or dynamic cryptographic libraries
compiler claims over an external verifier's parser or cryptographic implementation
address-string decoding and network-prefix interpretation inside CKB-VM
